|extra_sections=<h2>Publication history</h2>
The Players Committee first published this Virtual card on an old-style slip (before its December 2006 remaster of the set). Icons printed on the slip are written here in brackets ([Pilot], [Immune to Alter], [Immune to Sense], [Immune to Control]); ▲ and ▼ are printed as such. Versions of the Virtual Original card, in date order:
* '''Original (unnumbered)''' (this page): the Players Committee's Virtual Set #1a sheet (PDF made 5 March 2002; tournament-legal 9 March 2002). Full text: “Adds 4 to power of anything he pilots. While aboard a starship, it is immune to attrition < 5. Once per battle at same system (twice if with a Black Squadron pilot), may subtract 3 from a just drawn destiny. Immune to attrition < 5.”
* '''Numbered (black-on-white)''' ([[Darth Vader (V) (Virtual Set 1: Legacy) (Numbered black-on-white)|Darth Vader (V) — Numbered (black-on-white)]]): the Virtual Set #1 sheet hosted by Decipher (PDF made 6 March 2002; tournament-legal 9 March 2002). Full text: “Adds 4 to power of anything he pilots. While aboard a starship, it is immune to attrition < 5. Once per battle at same system (twice if with a Black Squadron pilot), may subtract 3 from a just drawn destiny. Immune to attrition < 5.” '''What changed:''' the words are the same as the previous version; the slip's look differs (Decipher's sheet prints Dark Side text boxes black on white and prints collector numbers V1•1–V1•12; the 5 March sheet prints Dark Side boxes white on black and no numbers). Listed as its own version because it is a separate publication (Bill, 12 November 2026).
* '''Remastered (2006)''' ([[Darth Vader (V) (Virtual Set 1: Legacy) (Remastered 2006)|Darth Vader (V) — Remastered (2006)]]): the Players Committee remaster sheet (Virtual Set 1: Legacy, official text as of 4 December 2006). Full text: “Adds 4 to power of anything he pilots. While aboard a starship, it is immune to attrition < 5. During battle at same system (twice if with a Black Squadron pilot), may cumulatively subtract 3 from a just drawn destiny. Immune to attrition < 5.” '''What changed:''' “Once per” → “During”; added “cumulatively”.
